Sam H.: Hey infra team — onboarding a new customer org in ap-northeast-3 (Osaka). Need quota increases for p5, p4d, and g5 instances plus ENI and EFA limits. Can someone help open the AWS request?
Priya K.: Can you paste the account ID and desired counts? Also any timeline constraints?
Sam H.: Account ID 987654321098. Timeline: they want to run a pilot next month (start ~2026-05-10). Requesting: p5.24xlarge x4, p4d.24xlarge x2, g5.12xlarge x6. ENIs per VPC bump to 2000, and EFA attach limit to 50.
Luca M.: Also call out placement group / AZ distribution — p4d needs single AZ, p5 supported across multiple AZs. We should request AZ capacity reservation for NRT-1a, NRT-1c if possible.
Priya K.: Good call. I can open the support case but prefer we file separate limit increase tickets per SKU + networking. AWS wants explicit region + limit type per case.
Infra-Bot: Created internal ticket INF-2026-089 for tracking. Link: https://intra.redwood/infra/tickets/INF-2026-089
Priya K.: Drafting support case: "Account 987654321098 - Limit increase request for ap-northeast-3: p5.24xlarge to 4, p4d.24xlarge to 2, g5.12xlarge to 6; EC2 Elastic Network Interfaces per Region to 2000; Elastic Fabric Adapter limit to 50. Need by 2026-05-05 for pilot readiness. Please confirm AZ capacity for p4d in ap-northeast-3 and advise on placement group recommendations."
Sam H.: Perfect. Also ask if there's any pre-approval for p5 on that account (we've seen long lead times without pre-auth).
Priya K.: Noted. Adding: "Is there a pre-approval path for p5/p4d class instances for new accounts? If so, please advise steps or contacts."
Priya K.: Opening cases now for: (1) EC2 On-Demand instance limits (p5/p4d/g5), (2) ENI limit, (3) EFA limit, (4) AZ capacity check. I'll post the AWS case IDs here when they come back.
AWS Support: Case 1234567891 opened for EC2 On-Demand limits. Estimated review 72 hours.
Priya K.: Case 1234567891 details: requesting p5.24xlarge -> 4, p4d.24xlarge -> 2, g5.12xlarge -> 6 in ap-northeast-3.
Sam H.: Thanks. Any chance to get p4d sooner? Pilot depends on it. If delayed we can maybe swap p4d->p5 mix?
Luca M.: p5 is good fallback but recall p4d has NVLink+EFA characteristics we rely on for some multi-node training. If p4d unavailable, we must adjust training configs. Keep both requests.
AWS Support: Case 1234567892 opened for ENI increase, case 1234567893 for EFA. ENI case est 48 hrs, EFA est 5 business days due to capacity check.
Priya K.: AWS asked for instance usage patterns and maximum concurrent instances per region. Sam can you paste expected usage profile (hours/day, batch vs interactive)?
Sam H.: Pilot usage: 24 GPUs total, three 8-hour shifts/day for 2 weeks heavy testing (~80% utilization), then steady-state ~8 GPUs average. Workloads are mixed (inference + short multi-node fine-tuning).
Priya K.: Submitted usage details to AWS support in case 1234567891.
Infra-Bot: INF-2026-089 updated: linked AWS cases 1234567891, 1234567892, 1234567893.
AWS Support: Quick update: p5 capacity in ap-northeast-3 looks available, p4d requires AZ-capacity validation — we'll notify. EFA requests routed to engineering for capacity check (can take up to 5 business days).
Sam H.: Thanks. Any recommended mitigations if p4d is denied? We could: (1) schedule training in another region (costy), (2) use p5 multi-node with NCCL over TCP (slower), (3) rent instances from marketplace providers for pilot. Thoughts?
Luca M.: Prefer (1) or (2). For pilot, spinning up in ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo) is OK if latency/cost acceptable. We should avoid marketplace for customer-sensitive data.
Priya K.: Also checking reserved capacity options with AWS sales — if customer signs a commit we can request capacity reservation which helps p4d availability. Adding that to sales checklist.
AWS Support: Case 1234567891 updated: p5 increases approved to requested counts. p4d approval pending AZ validation. g5 approved. We'll follow-up on p4d and EFA.
Sam H.: Great news on p5/g5. Thanks Priya and team.
Priya K.: When p4d finalizes we'll update INF ticket and schedule capacity onboarding. Also adding a runbook note: if EFA delayed, set fallback to g5 cluster with NCCL over TCP and bump batch sizes.
Luca M.: I'll make the runbook snippet now and post PR to infra-playbooks.
Infra-Bot: PR created: https://intra.redwood/infra/infra-playbooks/pull/452
AWS Support: Final update: p4d capacity in ap-northeast-3 confirmed for requested AZs, EFA limit increased to 50. All cases closed. Case IDs: 1234567891-3 closed.
Sam H.: That's excellent. Marking INF-2026-089 resolved. :white_check_mark:
Priya K.: Closing internal ticket after post-mortem checklist: verify placement groups, test multi-node with NCCL and EFA, confirm cost estimate for customer.
Luca M.: I'll run the integration smoke on 2026-05-06.
Sam H.: Thanks everyone. :pray:
